Overview
This listing features a highly efficient falling-rate belt dryer, meticulously engineered to deliver optimal performance for industrial drying applications. With a generous drying chamber volume of 3,040 litres, this unit stands out as a robust solution for large-scale moisture removal processes.

Key Specifications
Operating at an air temperature of 32 degrees Celsius, the dryer is capable of removing an impressive 219 kilograms of moisture per day. This level of efficiency ensures reliable throughput for demanding production environments. The batch drying cycle is precisely set at 44 hours, striking the ideal balance between thorough drying and operational productivity.

Operational Excellence
